nominal_clock_model: Explicit ES0392 revision allowlist 0x1003/0x2001/0x2003/0x2007; HSI64 PER_CK divided16. For the post-Y IDs, the nominal extra divide2 follows the pinned ST ADC_ConfigureBoostMode algorithm. This is an inference from manufacturer implementation, not a measured clock or silicon qualification.
regulator_policy: A 1-nominal-ms guard applies to all IDs. LDORDY is additionally required for revisionV/0x2003 only, as RM0433 Rev8 documents. IDs without that explicit flag guarantee use the timed guard.
calibration_policy: ADC1 andADC3 single-ended offset plus linearity, serialized; observe ADCAL clear and all six linearity-ready flags, then guard 1nominalms before enabling. Each wait is bounded, with a separate500ms core initialization bound.
adc_configuration: 10bit, single software-triggered conversion,810.5-cycle sampling, no DMA/interrupt/multimode; ADC2 remains deep-power-down. ADC3 VREFINT andVBAT paths are enabled only while dependent ADCs are disabled.
external_gpio: Only PA6/PB1 MODER and PUPDR fields become analog/no-pull; other pin fields and RCC fields are preserved.
w1c_policy: Stale EOC/OVR cause failure before a new conversion. Read DR, retain it, recheck OVR/EOC, then acknowledge EOS/EOSMP and verify. Cleanup preserves original core error history and resets only exclusively owned ADC12/ADC3.
open_items: Link into a versioned image and diagnostic record, with historical decoder and exact read-window tests.
Physical ADC timing, settling, calibration accuracy, noise, temperature and reference/divider uncertainty remain unqualified.
The model does not simulate analog behavior, undocumented silicon effects, or all applicable device errata.
